title: Peace & Rest
intro: Small children are wound up by a world with too much in it, and they cannot say so. This month is quieter than the rest on purpose. It is about bedtime, big feelings, and learning that stopping is safe.

keyScriptures.text: In peace I will lie down and sleep, for you alone, Lord, make me dwell in safety.
Come to me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest.

weeks.title: Stopping Is Safe
weeks.declaration: You are allowed to stop. Nothing goes wrong when you rest, and nobody is disappointed.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Father, slow this house down. Let our child learn that stopping is safe. Amen.

weeks.title: Big Feelings Get Smaller
weeks.declaration: When a feeling is very big, it gets smaller if you say it out loud to someone who loves you.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Lord, help us stay calm when our child cannot. Let us be the quiet in their storm. Amen.

weeks.title: Quiet Is Nice
weeks.declaration: Quiet is not boring. Some of the best bits of the day are the quiet ones.
weeks.parentsPrayer: God, give our child a taste for quiet in a very loud world. Amen.

weeks.title: You Can Sleep
weeks.declaration: You can go to sleep because you are safe, not because everything is tidy.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Father, give sleep to this child and to us. We cannot make it happen. Amen.

days.title: Stopping Is Safe
days.declaration: You are allowed to stop and rest. Nothing goes wrong when you do.

scripture.text: On the seventh day he rested.

days.title: You Can Sleep
days.declaration: You can go to sleep because you are safe. Someone else is awake.

scripture.text: In peace I will lie down and sleep.

days.title: Big Feelings Get Smaller
days.declaration: When a feeling is huge, saying it out loud makes it smaller.

scripture.text: Pour out your hearts to him.

days.title: Quiet Is Nice
days.declaration: Quiet is not boring. Some of the best bits of the day are quiet.

scripture.text: Be still, and know that I am God.

days.title: Come and Rest
days.declaration: When you are worn out, come to us. That is what we are for.

scripture.text: Come to me, all you who are weary.

days.title: God Does Not Sleep
days.declaration: You can sleep. The One looking after you never needs to.

scripture.text: He will neither slumber nor sleep.

days.title: Not Your Job to Worry
days.declaration: Worrying is not your job. You are allowed to let us carry things.

scripture.text: Do not worry about tomorrow.

days.title: Slow Down
days.declaration: Going slowly is allowed. Fast is not always better.

scripture.text: In quietness and trust is your strength.

days.title: A Cuddle Helps
days.declaration: When everything is too much, a cuddle is a very good plan.

scripture.text: As a mother comforts her child.

days.title: Breathing Slowly
days.declaration: When you are cross or scared, breathing slowly helps. Try it with us.

scripture.text: God is our refuge and strength.

days.title: Not Everything at Once
days.declaration: You do not have to do everything today. One thing is fine.

scripture.text: There is a time for everything.

days.title: Bedtime Is Good
days.declaration: Bedtime is not a punishment. It is how tomorrow gets to be good.

scripture.text: He grants sleep to those he loves.

days.title: Peace Is a Present
days.declaration: A quiet, calm feeling is a present from God. You can ask for it.

scripture.text: Peace I leave with you.

days.title: It Is Fine to Be Tired
days.declaration: Being tired is not naughty. Tired people need rest, not telling off.

scripture.text: He knows how we are formed.

days.title: Nothing to Finish
days.declaration: You do not have to finish everything before you rest.

scripture.text: My yoke is easy and my burden is light.

days.title: Loud Places End
days.declaration: Loud busy places end and then it is quiet again. You will be fine.

scripture.text: He leads me beside quiet waters.

days.title: Sitting Still
days.declaration: Sitting still with someone is a lovely thing to do. Try it for a minute.

scripture.text: Truly my soul finds rest in God.

days.title: Bad Dreams Finish
days.declaration: Bad dreams are not real and they finish. We are nearby.

scripture.text: When you lie down, your sleep will be sweet.

days.title: Being Cross Passes
days.declaration: Being very cross does not last. It goes, like weather.

scripture.text: Weeping may stay for the night.

days.title: Nobody Is Rushing You
days.declaration: Nobody here is rushing you. You can take your time.

scripture.text: With the Lord a day is like a thousand years.

days.title: Rest Before You Melt
days.declaration: Resting before you are completely worn out works better than after.

scripture.text: Come with me... and get some rest.

days.title: A Day Off
days.declaration: We have days when we do nothing much. Those are good days too.

scripture.text: Remember the Sabbath day by keeping it holy.

days.title: Safe to Be Tired
days.declaration: It is safe to be tired here. Nobody has to be good all the time.

scripture.text: Whoever dwells in the shelter of the Most High.

days.title: Say It to God
days.declaration: You can tell God when you feel funny inside. He is always listening.

scripture.text: Cast all your anxiety on him.

days.title: Hands Down
days.declaration: When your hands are tight, you can let them go. Try it now.

scripture.text: Cast your cares on the Lord.

days.title: Peace Guards You
days.declaration: God gives a peace that looks after your thoughts, especially at bedtime.

scripture.text: The peace of God will guard your hearts.

days.title: One Story, Then Sleep
days.declaration: Ordinary things at the same time each night help you feel safe. That is why we do them.

scripture.text: Establish the work of our hands.

days.title: Enough for Today
days.declaration: Today was enough. You do not have to do any more of it.

scripture.text: It is finished.

days.title: Quiet Voices
days.declaration: We will try to use quiet voices here. Quiet helps everyone.

scripture.text: And after the fire came a gentle whisper.

days.title: Morning Comes
days.declaration: The night ends and the morning comes. It always has.

scripture.text: His mercies are new every morning.

days.title: Keep the Quiet
days.declaration: We will keep having quiet times, even when life gets busier.

scripture.text: He refreshes my soul.
